claroDag.title: How a CLARO query becomes a plan
claroDag.caption: Conceptual illustration of the architecture described in the project summary. It is not a trace of a real query, does not show the full set of registered capabilities, and is not drawn to scale.

stages.label: Plan
stages.detail: A planner decomposes the user's question into a dependency-aware execution DAG and activates only the capabilities that question needs.

stages.label: Execute
stages.detail: Independent tasks run concurrently with bounded parallelism; dependent tasks wait for their inputs. Timeouts and failure isolation keep one failing branch from stalling the rest.

stages.label: Ground
stages.detail: Capabilities use LLM tool use and RAG-based structured retrieval to return typed, source-grounded results — including location-specific demographic, policy, and spatial context.

stages.label: Synthesize
stages.detail: Completed results stream to the interface as they finish, while conversational synthesis and speech generation proceed asynchronously.

reflectionPaths.title: Same state, two continuations
reflectionPaths.caption: Schematic of the counterfactual comparison. The three outcomes are the categories the project studies, not results from any specific problem.

state.label: Intermediate reasoning state
state.detail: A partial solution trajectory, frozen at the same point for both branches.

probe.label: Hidden-state probe
probe.detail: Reads the model's internal representation at this state and predicts whether reflection will help.

direct.label: Direct continuation
direct.detail: The model keeps reasoning without an explicit reflection step.

reflect.label: Reflection-induced continuation
reflect.detail: The model is prompted to reflect, then continues from the identical state.

outcomes.label: Reflection helps
outcomes.detail: The reflected branch reaches a better outcome than the direct one.

outcomes.label: No change
outcomes.detail: Both branches reach the same outcome; reflection spent computation without changing the result.

outcomes.label: Reflection hurts
outcomes.detail: The reflected branch ends worse than the direct one.

comparison.context: Values as reported in the CV, over 100 MATH problems, 376 intermediate states, and 4,512 rollouts. Scale shown from 0 to 1.
